_: Hand decisions for data-prep/strongs/derivations.py where the prose defeats the grammar. `from` is the parent list; empty means the entry is its own root. Each carries its reason.

H1145.why: Six clauses of spelling variants; the parentage, 'patron from H1144', is the last. The first clause with a code reads 'with H376 inserted', a note about a form.

H3778.why: An unbalanced ')' in the source swallows 'patronymically from H3777'.

H4310.why: 'an interrogative pronoun of persons, as H4100 is of things' — an analogy, not descent.

H5284.why: 'a place corresponding in name (but not identical) with H5279' — Strong's own 'not identical'.

H5882.why: 'עַיִן and the dual of H5695' — a compound whose first part is given only in Hebrew script; its own root like every compound with an unnamed part.

G1438.why: 'from a reflexive pronoun otherwise obsolete and the genitive case of G846' — a compound with an unnamed part.

G128.why: 'from (to scorch) and (the face, from G3700)' — a compound of two glossed parts; the code is the second part's own parent.

G611.why: 'from G575 and ;' — the source lost the second code; ἀποκρίνομαι is ἀπό + κρίνω.

G1768.why: 'from a (tenth) multiple of G1767 and G1767 itself' — both parts are ἐννέα.

H1787.why: '(Diyshon, the same as H1788' — an unclosed parenthetical hides the claim.

H2089.why: '(1 Samuel by permutation for H7716' — an unclosed parenthetical.

H4382.why: 'patrial from an unused name (the same as H4380)' — the parenthetical is the name.

H6397.why: 'patronymically from an unused name (from H6395)' — the parenthetical is the name's own parent.

H7320.why: '(or Romam from H7311 and H5828' — an unclosed parenthetical.

H930.why: 'in form a plural or H929, but really a singular of Egyptian derivation' — Strong's says the resemblance to H929 is only formal.

H2131.why: '(Isaiah 50:' never closes, so the rest of the entry reads as a parenthetical; the claim is 'from H2187'.

H4363.why: '(Ezra 2:2' never closes; the claim is 'from H3647'.

H4581.why: '(also מָעֻז' never closes; the claim is 'from H5810'.

H5448.why: '(only in the form סֻבָּל' never closes; the claim is 'from H5445'.

H7417.why: '(רִמֹּן' never closes; the claim is 'the same as H7416'.

H8141.why: '(in plural' never closes; the claim is 'from H8138'.

H8561.why: '(plural' never closes; the claim is 'from the same root as H8558'.

H1511.why: '(in the m' never closes; the claim is 'patrial from H1507'.

H4192.why: '(Psalm H48 (אֲבִירָם)' closes once for two openings; the claim is 'from H4191 and H1121'.
